summary: Describes version 1 of the Network Time Protocol (NTP) and gives its structure and implementation information. NTP synchronizes clocks across a hierarchy of time servers and keeps time accurate to within tens of milliseconds in most of the Internet. It replaces RFC 958 and was replaced by RFC 1119 and RFC 1305.

eli5.summary: Computers' clocks drift apart. NTP lets them ask more accurate clocks what time it is and adjust, so they all agree.

questions: how do computers synchronize their clocks
